product_one_liner.value: Talowiz provides AI recruiting agents that automate candidate sourcing, screening, assessments, interviews and hiring coordination for recruiters and talent-acquisition teams.

pricing_page.notes: Public credit-based, pay-as-you-go pricing page explains the offering and billing model, but does not publish numerical credit prices.

named_customers.notes: Homepage testimonials identify Rajesh Rajan, AVP HR at Vedantu, and Ruban Phukan, CEO of GoodGist.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 15 employees; this point count maps to the requested band.

hq_location.notes: Company profile lists Ashburn as headquarters; the website also gives a San Jose mailing address.

founded_year.notes: Company profile gives 2022; PitchBook instead gives 2021, and the founder profile dates his role to November 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains recruiting advice and product/marketing articles, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation/help-center link was found; the public product material provides marketing descriptions and FAQs rather than a multi-article documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public company careers page says there are no openings right now.

model_provider.notes: Section 7.3 states that Talowiz developed a custom AI model to personalize behavior and content by user persona; it does not identify an underlying third-party model or LLM provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Public compliance claims only, not independently verified certifications: the product article says SOC2 and GDPR/DPDP features are built in and describes the offering as SOC-compliant. The privacy policy makes GDPR commitments. Generic ISO wording does not establish ISO 27001 certification.

last_funding.notes: PitchBook records one completed Early Stage VC round and names FortyTwo.VC; the investor also lists Talowiz among companies it backs. Neither source discloses the round date or USD amount, so those fields are omitted.

raised_18mo.notes: Outside backing is documented, but the funding date is not disclosed, so it cannot be placed inside or outside 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public company careers page says there are no openings right now.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest explicit launch announcement found in readable history is the AI pipeline builder, dated 2026-02-10, before the 2026-05-09 cutoff; the blog index has no later launch within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available team directory does not expose a complete dated C-level/VP roster, and no qualifying dated join or departure announcement was verified for 2025-11-09 through 2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy explicitly says Mailchimp manages newsletters and transactional emails, and Google Analytics tracks website traffic. These establish marketing-system use, not a named sales CRM.
